query_normalized: virtual reality exposure therapy for anxiety: a meta-analysis psychology
rationale: The paper is a review of virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET) for phobias, which is directly within the domain of VR exposure therapy for anxiety disorders (phobias being anxiety disorders). It satisfies criterion (a)/(e) as canonical prior work on VRET for anxiety-related conditions that a meta-analysis on VRET for anxiety would cite.
